issue: runner.Call.resolved_model recorded next(iter(modelUsage)), the FIRST key only. Claude Code makes a small auxiliary haiku call alongside the requested model, and dict ordering put haiku first, so 1793 of 1800 calls recorded 'haiku' regardless of the tier requested. This is a PROVENANCE-FIELD defect, not an experimental one.

verification_1_direct.method: 12 concurrent calls under the run's exact flags, capturing the full modelUsage map
verification_1_direct.conclusion: the requested model produces the answer; the haiku entry is auxiliary

verification_2_from_the_run_itself.method: cost and output tokens per call, computed from calls.jsonl
verification_2_from_the_run_itself.conclusion: three distinct cost and verbosity profiles; the tiers are not the same model

fix: runner.Call now records models_used (every modelUsage key) alongside resolved_model, which is the requested model's own key when present. Applied after this run; the run is not re-scored because the defect never touched which model answered.
